name: claudio-audiobook
description: Create audiobooks with local Kokoro voices. Ask for a course; Claude writes it and this turns it into audio. Nothing leaves your computer.
long_description: Say something like "create a python course audiobook". Claude writes the text, then this extension renders it with the Kokoro voice model on your own computer (the model, about 330 MB, downloads once on first use). Output: one m4b file with chapters, or mp3/wav. Voice, speed, pauses and more can be set in the chat or as defaults below.

tools.name: make_audiobook
tools.description: Turn text (or a file) into an audiobook, as a background job, or preview it with dry_run.

tools.name: setup_check
tools.description: Check the voice model, ffmpeg and output folder.

prompts.name: write_audiobook
prompts.description: Write a spoken-style course on a topic and turn it into an audiobook.
prompts.text: Create an audiobook course on: ${arguments.topic}. Level: ${arguments.level}. About ${arguments.length_minutes} minutes. Write it as spoken markdown with one # heading per chapter, preview with make_audiobook dry_run, then render it.

output_dir.title: Audiobooks folder
output_dir.description: Where finished audiobooks are saved. Leave empty for the Audiobooks folder in your home folder.

voice.title: Default voice
voice.description: A Kokoro voice such as af_heart, bf_emma, am_adam, or a blend like af_heart:0.6,af_sky:0.4.

model.title: Voice model
model.description: full (best quality, 330 MB) or lite (92 MB, faster).

format.title: Default format
format.description: m4b (one file with chapters), mp3 or wav.
